must_haves: The woman remains recognizably the same person, with the same expression and pose.
Her curly hair and sweater are preserved with clean, natural-looking edges.
Sand and blue sea replace the park background.
The portrait remains head-and-shoulders rather than inventing a full body.
The square image looks like a coherent photograph, not a visibly pasted cutout.

answer_sheet.Size and added text: One square image at the standard free size. No added text.
